title: centralize-enterprise-model-request-enrichment-and-risk-tagging
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a centralized enrichment step in the model catalog intake pipeline that automatically tags customer-submitted model requests with enterprise-relevant metadata and computes a risk / priority score. Goal: reduce manual triage, accelerate enterprise intake lanes, and ensure consistent routing to compliance, infra, and stewarding teams. This ticket scopes the PM design, acceptance criteria, and the cross-functional work breakdown for an MVP enrichment + scoring service (no UI polishing).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form collects or infers required enterprise fields: customer_tier, data_residency, compliance_regimes, expected_qps, latency_slo, model_provenance, training_data_flags, requested_pin_duration
Auto-enrichment service populates provenance, recommended quantization profile, and initial compatibility flags using model metadata and a lightweight probe job
Computed priority_score (0-100) is stored on the request and can be used to place the request into one of three queues: enterprise-fastpath, standard, deferred
Priority score formula and thresholds documented in Confluence and visible to Console reviewers
Security review flag is set when training_data_flags include: PII, regulated-data, or <custom-regulated-sources>, and triggers required-review workflow
End-to-end integration tests run in staging demonstrating routing and a sample canary roll to the 10% enterprise-fastpath queue
tasks: PM: finalize enrichment schema and priority scoring rubric (fields + weights)
Design: low-fi intake form update and Console reviewer panel mockups
Eng (backend): implement enrichment microservice and scoring engine, API to attach metadata to requests
Eng (infra): staging probe job template and credentials sandbox for safe model metadata inspection
Security: review training_data_flags mapping and provide blocklist/exemption rules
Console: add reviewer UI column for priority_score + quick actions (escalate, require-review, assign steward)
QA: integration tests for routing and security gating
Documentation: Confluence playbook + runbook for on-call escalation for flagged requests

decisions: Use a single composite priority_score (0-100) to drive routing instead of multiple independent flags to make downstream queues simpler.
Default enterprise-fastpath threshold: priority_score >= 75. Standard: 40-74. Deferred: <40.
Requested pin duration contributes to score but is capped at +10 to avoid gaming by long pin requests.
Security review is mandatory for any request with 'regulated-data' training_data_flags; enrichment service will auto-set 'security_review_required' field.
